name: Excelsior Hotel Gallia
positioning: Excelsior Hotel Gallia, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Milan: a hotel beside Milano Centrale station on Piazza Duca d'Aosta, with Italian-made design, a two-floor Shiseido spa and a seventh-floor indoor pool with panoramic views
best_for: Travelers arriving by train who want a base beside Milano Centrale for Milan and day trips
Design lovers drawn to Italian-made furniture and a large art collection
Spa-focused stays with a two-floor wellness center and a private spa suite for two

facts.text: The hotel stands beside Piazza Duca d'Aosta and Milano Centrale station.
Lake Como, Venice and Florence are a train journey away from the hotel.
All of the hotel's furniture is made in Italy, with several pieces produced with Milanese artisans and designers.
Rooms feature handcrafted and modern elements by local ateliers including B&B Italia, Cassina, Fendi Casa and Flos.
Bathrooms showcase Botticino or Emperador marble with Belle Epoque bronze accents.
Signature Suites take inspiration from Italian creators such as Gio Ponti and Castiglioni, and many feature their designs.
Panoramic Suites have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of landmarks and the cityscape.
The wellness center has a Himalayan salt cabin, hydrotherapy sessions, wet and dry saunas and a steam room.
The Private Spa Suite has a treatment room for two, a jacuzzi, sauna, steam room, ice room and relaxation area.
The hotel's wine cellar holds over 700 labels.
The head concierge is a member of Les Clefs d'Or.

highlights.text: The Katara Royal Suite is a four-bedroom suite on the seventh floor with two terraces.
The Gallia Health Club and Shiseido Spa Milan spans the sixth and seventh floors, with panoramic views of the historic city center.
The indoor pool is on the seventh floor and has panoramic views.
The hotel has a collection of more than 500 art pieces, including paintings, sculptures and photographs, designed by Studio Marco Piva exclusively for the property.
Atelier Suites are conceived as art galleries, with unique lighting and colour use.

considerations.text: The hotel sits beside Milano Centrale station on Piazza Duca d'Aosta, a major transport hub.
WhataHotel notes the busy train station location may be noisy for light sleepers.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
